why: The families audit reports SITES, not defects, and says so in its own
`caveat_not_split_source_vs_doc`. Its predecessor CODATA sweep quoted a raw
site count as a defect count and had to retract: that bullet was wrong for
87 % of its own number. This ledger is the split the caveat asks for, keyed
(file, literal) so it is re-checkable rather than re-eyeballed.
a  CODE THAT COMPUTES  -- the literal feeds arithmetic (or is published as
a q0 into a witness). These are the real defects.
b  DELIBERATE CLASSIFIER CONSTANT -- the code must NAME a specific,
superseded, or held-fixed value in order to detect, compare against, or
reproduce it. Migrating one BREAKS the detector. Never migrate; exclude
c  DOCUMENTATION -- docstring or comment only; quoted for exposition,
including audits that quote the superseded value on purpose.
d  TEST FIXTURE -- a pinned expected value. Migrating makes the assertion
tautological (the code would assert it equals itself).

why_each_class_a_row_is_deferred: The first version of this ledger deferred every remaining class-(a) row
with one reason -- 'blocked on #5500' -- and that reason did not survive
review. It argues against TRANSCRIBING C. It does not argue against
READING the anchor, which is what the migration is: a site that calls
`_q0_value_for_anchor` is pinned to nothing and follows the anchor before
and after #5500. The ledger's own sentence said as much.
Re-measured, the remainder splits three ways:
a-cost-deferred        (32)  The file EMITS A WITNESS. Reading the
anchor moves it B -> A now, and #5500 moves
it A -> C, so the same witness is
regenerated twice and each regeneration is
a place an unexplained number can slip
through -- which this PR measured happening
three times. A real cost argument, and a
different one from the original wording.
a-correctness-deferred  (5)  Reading the anchor does NOT close the
defect. Two carry a frozen tr_M computed at
the old pin (moving q0 alone CREATES a
straddle); two read y_lambda from a B-built
witness (moving q0 to the anchor makes the
straddle exact-A-vs-B rather than closing
it); one computes nothing at all.
migratable now          (0)  Empty as of this PR -- because the 8 that
were in it have been migrated. Established
by measurement, not by family label: a
scan for `WitnessBuilder` / `json.dump` /
`.save(` found 10 of the 45 write nothing,
and 2 of those 10 turned out to carry a
matched-pair constraint on a second reading,
so they moved to correctness-deferred.
The 8 migrated cost nothing to migrate: no witness to regenerate, all 8
re-run at exit 0 with their assertions still passing, and `git status`
after the runs shows no witness file touched.
